An interstate move starts with a good inventory

List your boxes, furniture and large items, then share access conditions and dates for both addresses. Confirm packing, loading, transport and assembly separately.

Make your inventory useful

Include box counts, sizes, weights and furniture photos. Identify pianos, fragile items, appliances and items requiring disassembly so the team can assess preparation and handling.

Prepare access at both ends

Explain floors, elevator reservations, parking and loading-zone access. Mention building restrictions, permitted moving hours and any place a large truck cannot enter.

Confirm the full scope

Ask whether packing, disassembly, assembly, protective materials and waste handling are included. You can discuss your car and belongings together, but confirm their transport methods and arrival dates separately.

Keep a handover record

Use a checklist and photos when handing over your items. Confirm contacts and collection arrangements. Check quantities and condition on arrival and report any concerns promptly.

This guide reorganizes public information from the original sites. It is not a live quote or a carrier agreement. Confirm order-specific details with the team and your contract.
